facts.statement: The annual BDUK release was published on 11 June 2026.
The release is classified as official statistics.
The reporting period runs from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
BDUK interventions delivered an estimated 192,570 premises in 2025/26.
Annual delivery increased by 42,280 premises.
The annual increase was 28%.
Cumulative subsidised gigabit delivery reached 1,418,410 premises.
GIS contracts accounted for 139,490 premises.
GIS contracts accounted for 72% of annual delivery.
Voucher schemes accounted for 30,530 premises.
Voucher schemes accounted for 16% of annual delivery.
Superfast and Hubs interventions accounted for 22,550 premises.
Rural areas accounted for 173,190 delivered premises.
Rural areas represented 90% of annual delivery.
Residential properties accounted for 173,270 premises.
Residential properties represented 90% of annual delivery.
Commercial properties accounted for 17,790 premises.
England accounted for 145,110 delivered premises.
Scotland accounted for 30,530 delivered premises.
Wales accounted for 15,430 delivered premises.
Northern Ireland accounted for 1,470 delivered premises.
The South West recorded 27,630 premises delivered.
Yorkshire and the Humber recorded 27,090 premises delivered.
The North West recorded 25,100 premises delivered.
